{{Quote|''Yellowblade's Landing'' is a suitably inhospitable place for a pair of ''lightsaber-wielding'' fugitives to avoid detection.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="TSH" />}}
The '''Orto Norwe system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="FF23">{{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}}</ref> [[Orto Norwe]].<ref name="TSH" /><ref name="Email" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirmed in [[March]] [[2023]] that [[Yellowblade's Landing]] was a location on Orto Norwe, thus meaning that the Orto Norwe system was created to provide a name for the ice world featured in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''.<ref name="Email" />
